name: 4 · Desert Detour
rule_text: Heat visits one announced lane every 28 seconds, damaging plants by 25.

levels.title: 4-01 · Sand in the Seed Packet
levels.briefing: Heat visits one announced lane every 28 seconds, damaging plants by 25. Establish economy and cover all five lanes.
levels.joke: The welcome mat says hello, not all-you-can-eat. The cactus is the only local with appropriate work clothes. Cardboard Box zombies hide behind others: use low shots, catapults or thorns. Balloons fly over ground plants: bring anti-air. Slingshots target flying plants.

levels.title: 4-02 · Solar Oven Economics
levels.briefing: Heat visits one announced lane every 28 seconds, damaging plants by 25. Build sun production before doubling your shooters.
levels.joke: Sunlight remains free. The zombie subscription is harder to cancel. The oasis is rated one star for excessive zombies. Cardboard Box zombies hide behind others: use low shots, catapults or thorns. Balloons fly over ground plants: bring anti-air. Slingshots target flying plants.

levels.title: 4-03 · Mummy Returns Department
levels.briefing: Heat visits one announced lane every 28 seconds, damaging plants by 25. A new specialist joins the queue. Read its almanac counter before starting.
levels.joke: Local traffic cone promoted to middle management. The mummy has a lifetime warranty and intends to use it. Cardboard Box zombies hide behind others: use low shots, catapults or thorns. Slingshots target flying plants.

levels.joke: Twenty plants. Infinite unsolicited gardening opinions. The cactus is the only local with appropriate work clothes. Cardboard Box zombies hide behind others: use low shots, catapults or thorns. Slingshots target flying plants.

levels.joke: The mowers have requested a mental-health day. Sand is nature’s most persistent customer-support ticket. Cardboard Box zombies hide behind others: use low shots, catapults or thorns. Balloons fly over ground plants: bring anti-air. Slingshots target flying plants.

levels.briefing: Heat visits one announced lane every 28 seconds, damaging plants by 25. A new specialist joins the queue. Read its almanac counter before starting.
levels.joke: Turn signals are apparently a living-person feature. The mummy has a lifetime warranty and intends to use it. Cardboard Box zombies hide behind others: use low shots, catapults or thorns. Balloons fly over ground plants: bring anti-air. Slingshots target flying plants.

levels.title: 4-09 · The Oasis Reserve
levels.briefing: Heat visits one announced lane every 28 seconds, damaging plants by 25. Hold 4500 unspent sun and clear all waves. Collection continues after the last zombie.
levels.joke: Four thousand sun in savings. Still cannot afford a garden shed. The camel refuses to validate parking. Cardboard Box zombies hide behind others: use low shots, catapults or thorns. Balloons fly over ground plants: bring anti-air. Slingshots target flying plants.

levels.title: 4-10 · Roots Have Rights
levels.briefing: Heat visits one announced lane every 28 seconds, damaging plants by 25. Lose no more than 3 plants to attacks or shoveling. Single-use plants do not count.
levels.joke: The roots have formed a union. Please keep them alive. The oasis is rated one star for excessive zombies. Cardboard Box zombies hide behind others: use low shots, catapults or thorns. Balloons fly over ground plants: bring anti-air.

levels.title: 4-11 · Internship Excavation
levels.briefing: Heat visits one announced lane every 28 seconds, damaging plants by 25. Clear the fast waves within 330 seconds.
levels.joke: An internship with excellent exposure and no pulse. The cactus is the only local with appropriate work clothes. Cardboard Box zombies hide behind others: use low shots, catapults or thorns. Balloons fly over ground plants: bring anti-air. Slingshots target flying plants.

levels.title: 4-12 · Ruins Under Renovation
levels.briefing: Heat visits one announced lane every 28 seconds, damaging plants by 25. Dark crossed tiles cannot be planted. Zombies still travel through them.
levels.joke: These tiles are reserved for a future parking lot. The oasis is rated one star for excessive zombies. Cardboard Box zombies hide behind others: use low shots, catapults or thorns. Balloons fly over ground plants: bring anti-air. Slingshots target flying plants.

levels.title: 4-13 · Oasis Tasting Menu
levels.briefing: Heat visits one announced lane every 28 seconds, damaging plants by 25. The supplied seed menu is fixed. Supplies are borrowed even if not yet unlocked.
levels.joke: The chef insists the menu is a tactical constraint. The mummy has a lifetime warranty and intends to use it.

levels.title: 4-14 · Five Wilted Reports
levels.briefing: Heat visits one announced lane every 28 seconds, damaging plants by 25. Lose no more than 5 plants. Transformations and deliberate single-use plants are exempt.
levels.joke: Five losses are a tragedy. Six are a failed level. The camel refuses to validate parking. Cardboard Box zombies hide behind others: use low shots, catapults or thorns. Balloons fly over ground plants: bring anti-air. Slingshots target flying plants.

levels.title: 4-15 · Graft Like an Egyptian
levels.briefing: Heat visits one announced lane every 28 seconds, damaging plants by 25. Create at least 2 grafts and clear the waves. Same-plant twin hybrids count too.
levels.joke: Botany: now with legally questionable welding. Sand is nature’s most persistent customer-support ticket.

levels.title: 4-16 · Sandblast Artillery
levels.briefing: Heat visits one announced lane every 28 seconds, damaging plants by 25. No plants or seeds required. Click a board tile to fire a free recharging area cannon.
levels.joke: No plants today. The salad has authorized artillery. The cactus is the only local with appropriate work clothes.

levels.title: 4-17 · Cactus Dress Code
levels.briefing: Heat visits one announced lane every 28 seconds, damaging plants by 25. Cover the specialist wave; avoid relying on a single front wall.
levels.joke: This wave has read the terms and conditions. You have not. The oasis is rated one star for excessive zombies. Cardboard Box zombies hide behind others: use low shots, catapults or thorns. Balloons fly over ground plants: bring anti-air. Slingshots target flying plants.

levels.title: 4-18 · Bucket Archaeology
levels.briefing: Heat visits one announced lane every 28 seconds, damaging plants by 25. Armor soaks projectiles. Save explosives for tightly grouped helmets.
levels.joke: Buckets protect brains, not fragile workplace morale. The camel refuses to validate parking. Cardboard Box zombies hide behind others: use low shots, catapults or thorns. Balloons fly over ground plants: bring anti-air. Slingshots target flying plants.

levels.title: 4-19 · Twice Dead, Once Paid
levels.briefing: Heat visits one announced lane every 28 seconds, damaging plants by 25. Summoners and small runners require rear coverage, not just one front tank. No breaches: interns are not allowed indoors.
levels.joke: Fresh interns have arrived. Their onboarding is your problem. The mummy has a lifetime warranty and intends to use it. Cardboard Box zombies hide behind others: use low shots, catapults or thorns. Balloons fly over ground plants: bring anti-air.

levels.title: 4-20 · Sunset Without Sun
levels.briefing: Heat visits one announced lane every 28 seconds, damaging plants by 25. No sky sun. Start from the supplied savings and plant your own economy.
levels.joke: Solar power at night: accounting would like a word. The mummy has a lifetime warranty and intends to use it.

levels.title: 4-21 · Save the Oasis
levels.briefing: Heat visits one announced lane every 28 seconds, damaging plants by 25. No planting. A mature garden is provided. Protect it; click a damaged plant for a free 1200-HP repair every 3 seconds. Crafted tools are optional.
levels.joke: The garden is already planted. Your job description says keep it that way. The cactus is the only local with appropriate work clothes.

levels.title: 4-22 · Forty-Five Hundred Degrees
levels.briefing: Heat visits one announced lane every 28 seconds, damaging plants by 25. Collect a total of 4500 sun in this battle. Spending does not reduce this total.
levels.joke: Collect 4000 sun. Do not stare directly at the counter. The oasis is rated one star for excessive zombies. Cardboard Box zombies hide behind others: use low shots, catapults or thorns. Balloons fly over ground plants: bring anti-air. Slingshots target flying plants.

levels.title: 4-23 · Drought Rations
levels.briefing: Heat visits one announced lane every 28 seconds, damaging plants by 25. Fixed five-seed deck (graft two Pod Shooters into a Twin Pod for double fire) and a total limit of 22 planting actions.
levels.joke: The seeds were packed by a minimalist. Sand is nature’s most persistent customer-support ticket.

levels.title: 4-24 · Desert Rush Hour
levels.briefing: Heat visits one announced lane every 28 seconds, damaging plants by 25. Long mixed assault. Pace your economy: the waves never stop being polite about it.
levels.joke: The committee has decided to attack simultaneously. The camel refuses to validate parking. Cardboard Box zombies hide behind others: use low shots, catapults or thorns. Balloons fly over ground plants: bring anti-air. Slingshots target flying plants.

levels.title: 4-25 · Furnace Inspection Day
levels.briefing: Heat visits one announced lane every 28 seconds, damaging plants by 25. Two giant arrivals with a rebuilding window. Counter its special ability, then clear the field.
levels.joke: The giant brought a club. The homeowners association brought a fine. Sand is nature’s most persistent customer-support ticket. Cardboard Box zombies hide behind others: use low shots, catapults or thorns. Balloons fly over ground plants: bring anti-air. Slingshots target flying plants.
